claims.evidence: Only the box and manuals are visible; the camera body itself is not shown.
The physical condition of the camera and lens cannot be assessed as they are wrapped or not shown.
Functional testing requires a video of the device operating.

risks.risk: The bubble wrap may not contain the items described on the boxes.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera body, lens, and gimbal unpacked and placed next to their respective boxes.
risks.if_unproven: as empty boxes and manuals only

risks.risk: High shutter count indicating a heavily used professional sensor.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count from a recent RAW file uploaded to a checker.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit near end-of-life

risks.risk: Sensor damage or fungus/scratches on the lens glass.
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photos of the camera sensor and the front/rear lens elements.

risks.risk: Gimbal motors may be burnt out or unbalanced.
risks.proof: Video showing the Zhiyun gimbal powering on and stabilizing a mounted camera.

proof_requests: Photos of the Nikon D750 body from all angles (front, back, top, bottom).
Photo of the 50mm lens glass (front and back).
Photo of the Zhiyun gimbal out of the box.
A photo of the camera screen showing the menu or a captured image to prove it powers on.
A screenshot of the shutter count.
response.reason: The witness only saw boxes and manuals; the actual camera, lens, and gimbal are not visible in the photos, making even a worst-case valuation of the hardware impossible.
